Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus is a composite organizational designation representing two hospitals in Denmark. It is tracked in the national clinical quality databases, specifically the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), which evaluates healthcare quality across the country [^src1]. The entity is situated within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] [^src4]. The designation is particularly significant because it is used as a combined reporting unit in detailed hospital-level analyses for Indikator 1, specifically in instances where the clinical results fail to meet the established national standards [^src1].

In the AFDK annual report covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the hospital unit's performance was evaluated across several clinical quality indicators. For [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who undergo echocardiography, Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus recorded a compliance rate of 76.5% (95% CI: 72.7–80.0) [^src2]. This performance was part of a broader evaluation of regional and local healthcare units to assess adherence to the national standard of ≥80% [^src2]. 

Additionally, the hospital unit is evaluated for other quality metrics in the report. It recorded an 85.0% compliance rate for an indicator tracked in the earlier sections of the report [^src1], a 90.1% rate for a metric detailed on page 36 [^src3], and an 88.0% rate for a metric on page 42 [^src4]. These evaluations form part of the broader effort by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) to identify top and bottom performers in the Danish healthcare system and drive quality improvement initiatives [^src3].
